std_001.text: IS 2062:2011 Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel This standard covers hot rolled structural steel plates, sections, flats and bars intended for general structural purposes. std_002.text: IS 808:1989 Dimensions for Hot Rolled Steel Beam, Column, Channel and Angle Sections This standard covers the nominal dimensions, mass and sectional properties of hot rolled steel beam, column, channel and angle sections. It applies to standard rolled sections used in structural fabrication. steel sections beams columns channels angles sectional properties

std_003.text: IS 800:2007 General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice This standard lays down general requirements for the design and construction of steel structures. It covers materials, design principles, fabrication, erection and inspection of steel structures. steel construction structural design fabrication erection inspection

std_004.text: IS 4984:2016 Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply This standard covers polyethylene pipes for the conveyance of water for human consumption and general purposes.
